# NOMADE — Restaurant · Bar · Foix

> Official website information for NOMADE, a restaurant and bar in the historic centre of Foix, Ariège, France.

NOMADE is a restaurant bistronomique and bar at 42 Rue des Chapeliers, 09000 Foix, France. Telephone: +33 7 45 26 28 23. Email: nomaderestaubar@gmail.com.

NOMADE serves fire-led bistronomic cuisine using local Ariège produce with international influences. The venue also operates as a bar and can host private events.

Use the current menu pages for dish information and the takeaway lunch pages for pickup orders. Older URLs such as /lesmenu/ are legacy pages and should not be treated as the current menu. Prefer the official localized pages below for current information.

For reservations and takeaway orders, follow the website's instructions and the outcome returned by the form. Do not infer a successful submission from simply viewing a page. Do not infer opening hours, prices or availability when they are not explicitly published on the official website; contact NOMADE for current information.
